title: Marlowe & Finch Alterations Intake Guidance: Acceptance, Quotes, Promised Dates and Deposits
content:
This is the rule the Marlowe & Finch Alterations intake desk applies when a garment is dropped off and a ticket is opened.

## 1. Acceptance

1. A garment is accepted in the service class that covers it.
2. A garment not bought at Marlowe & Finch is accepted only in a class that accepts garments not bought at Marlowe & Finch.
3. Where the class requires a measuring appointment, the tailor measures the customer at drop-off; where the class requires a needed-by date, the needed-by date is recorded on the ticket.
4. When the needed-by date is fewer than the class's lead-day figure in calendar days after the drop-off date, the ticket is accepted only with rush service, and is declined when rush service is not available or its turnaround would miss the date.

## 2. Quote and price list

The quote uses the price list in force on the drop-off date, and a written quote is honored for the class's quote-validity days.

## 3. Promised date

The promised date is the drop-off date plus the class's standard turnaround in business days, plus the class's peak-season extra days when the drop-off date falls in one of the class's peak-season months, plus the outsourced extra business days for outsourced work. With rush service it is the drop-off date plus the class's rush turnaround in business days.

## 4. Deposit at drop-off

> A deposit of the class's deposit percentage of the quoted total, but at least the class's minimum deposit and never more than the quoted total, is taken at drop-off where the deposit percentage is above 0.

**Status.** For a deposit worked out after drop-off and before the tailor starts the work, this clause is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current pre-work deposit terms. A deposit already taken at drop-off remains under this clause.

## 5. Returns of altered merchandise

Altering a Marlowe & Finch purchase ends its eligibility for return or exchange, except for a defect unrelated to the alteration.

## Worked cases (hypothetical figures)

- **Lead time, both sides.** In a class whose lead-day figure is 21: a needed-by date 20 calendar days after drop-off is fewer than 21, so the ticket is accepted only with rush service; a needed-by date exactly 21 calendar days after drop-off is not fewer than 21, so this condition does not apply.
- **Declined.** With the needed-by date below the lead-day figure, a ticket in a class that sells no rush service is declined; so is a ticket whose rush turnaround would end after the needed-by date.
- **Promised date.** In a class with a 10-business-day turnaround and 5 peak-season extra days, a drop-off in a peak month is promised 15 business days after the drop-off date; outside the peak months, 10 business days. Under rush in a class with a 4-business-day rush turnaround, it is promised 4 business days after drop-off.
- **Deposit at drop-off.** With a 50 percent deposit, a 50.00 USD minimum and a quoted total of 80.00 USD, half of the quote is 40.00 USD, so the minimum of 50.00 USD is taken; with a quoted total of 30.00 USD, the deposit would be capped at the quoted total of 30.00 USD.

superseded_clauses: A deposit of deposit_pct of the quoted_total, but at least deposit_min_usd and never more than the quoted_total, is taken at drop-off where deposit_pct is above 0.
